title: Non Abelian Twisted Reidemeister Torsion for Fibered Knots
note: Canad. Math. Bull. 49(1) (2006), 55-71; arXiv:math/0403304v2. Verified via Crossref REST API (DOI 10.4153/cmb-2006-006-0) and arXiv API (2026-11-28). Computes non-abelian Ad-twisted Reidemeister torsion of fibered knots in S^3 from the monodromy action on the fiber group (Section 3, Main Theorem), with explicit evaluations on torus knots and the figure-eight knot 4_1 (Section 5).
